summary: All three hyperscalers beat cloud estimates in Q1 2026. Google Cloud led growth at +63% YoY ($20B quarterly revenue, first time). Azure grew ~40%; AWS grew 28% but at fastest pace in 15 quarters. Google Cloud backlog >$460B. Combined AI capex from all four (AMZN, GOOGL, MSFT, META) = $725B in 2026, up 77% YoY. Microsoft's capex $190B for calendar 2026, $25B attributable to rising memory costs.
